reason: My admin is always weeks behind on the supply-shop nota and I lose track of what the guys actually spent on site. The free 40 docs costs me nothing to test on old chat history, and if it reads the handwritten nota properly, $45 a month is nothing next to one double-paid material run.

would_change_my_mind: If the free trial misreads the handwritten nota or misses a duplicate I plant on purpose, I'm out.
